heroHeadline: Merz at One Year: Record-Low Approval, AfD Surge, and Trump's NATO Challenge
heroSubtitle: Chancellor Friedrich Merz marks his first anniversary with 15% approval ratings — the lowest of any postwar German leader — as the AfD overtakes CDU in polls (28% vs 24%) for the first time. Trump's order to withdraw 5,000 US troops from Germany over Iran policy disputes and threats of 25% EU car tariffs have sent shockwaves through the transatlantic alliance. Germany's CDU-SPD coalition grapples with internal warfare over welfare cuts while simultaneously reaching Europe's highest defense budget in 36 years at 2.3% of GDP.
footerNote: Data sourced from official German federal records (Bundesarchiv, Bundestag, Bundesregierung), major German and international media, and EU/NATO/international bodies. Historical data draws on scholarly consensus.
